name: bao-browser-m0
description: Bao desktop browser control and native-messaging extension.

scripts.lint: eslint desktop/src desktop/test extension/src web/src shared --max-warnings 0
scripts.arch:check: depcruise desktop/src extension/src web/src shared --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known && depcruise desktop/src extension/src web/src shared --config .dependency-cruiser.runtime.cjs
scripts.arch:prune: depcruise desktop/src extension/src web/src shared --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --baseline --baseline-mode shrink-only
scripts.check:static: npm run baselines:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run arch:check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run typecheck:extension && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test:desktop:integration: npm run build:desktop && node desktop/test/run-live.mjs browser.test.js && node desktop/test/run-live.mjs drift.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:desktop:unit
scripts.eval:nightly: tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json && node desktop/dist/desktop/src/app/cli.js eval nightly
scripts.eval:judge-agree: tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json && node desktop/dist/desktop/src/app/cli.js eval judge-agree
